label: Logging
summary: Server logging helpers and message-output caveats.
must_follow: Use ErrorMes for messages that must be written even when normal user-message logging is disabled.
Treat UsrMes, ErrorMes, and InfoMes as server log functions, not UI display functions.
Avoid logging secrets or sensitive runtime values.
avoid: Do not claim UsrMes displays a message to the end user.
Do not use logging as error handling when caller-visible behavior depends on the result.

elements.name: UsrMes
elements.summary: Writes a user message to the user log and returns the formatted log text.

elements.name: ErrorMes
elements.summary: Logs an error message and returns the resulting message string.

elements.name: InfoMes
elements.summary: Logs an informational user message and returns the same formatted string as UsrMes.
